### 2026-10-06 — Researched, made a plan an

**4h**

Researched, made a plan an

![Unsaved Image 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6MqvkXosxHCfqa1CwuCa7WmkXL904V8m/0f7eea7e26cf09f307226988f944c8f9c8d00c4ab81d31092422f5672ea9e1bf.jpg)

d design, started a rough flow of control for code, and 40% of the PCB designing done!

Refreshed my ki-cad memory(hadn't touched it for a loooong time, practically forgot it 😭 ).

I am going with a modular approach, 3 macro keys, and a dial with return to position feature.

I didn't wan't to go with the generic route of using a potentiometer and instead I will be using a motor for the dial.
